title: /reference answer/resend POST+PUT registered in router but missing from auth/csrf.gleam should_skip — session-bearing referees get 403 on every mutation
evidence:
router.gleam:80: `use <- csrf.validate(req, ctx.config.secret_key)`
router.gleam:968-973:
    http.Post, ["reference", token, "answer"] ->
      form_handler.handle_answer_post(req, ctx.config, token)
    http.Put, ["reference", token, "answer"] ->
      form_handler.handle_answer_put(req, ctx.config, token)
    http.Post, ["reference", token, "resend"] ->
      form_handler.handle_resend(req, ctx.config, token)
csrf.gleam:100-102:
    ["dsar", _] -> True
    ["erase", _] -> True
    _ -> False
csrf.gleam validate_token: `Error(_) ->
      // No session cookie — let the session middleware handle the 401
      handler()`
detail: csrf.validate wraps every request; the /reference arms are not in should_skip, so any browser holding an rt_session cookie is 403'd (forms/JS send no x-csrf-token). Anonymous referees pass (no cookie), so tests are green; the dsar/erase arms exist exactly for this token-gated case.
recommended_fix: Add `["reference", ..] -> True` to auth/csrf.gleam should_skip (the dsar/erase precedent) and pin it in a csrf unit test, so the mutation arms pass for session-bearing referees too.

title: get_form_context_by_form_token selects rc.form_token that no consumer reads; the justification comment is contradicted by the handler
evidence:
get_form_context_by_form_token.sql:9: `-- form_token itself is selected: the resend flow needs the CURRENT token to`
get_form_context_by_form_token.sql:15: `       rc.form_token,`
form_handler.gleam:603: `      form_token: new_token,`
grep of server/src + server/test for row.form_token / GetFormContextByFormTokenRow.form_token consumers: none outside sql.gleam
detail: The resend flow builds the fresh URL from the handler-minted new_token (form_handler.gleam:603), never from the row's stored token. The SELECTed column and its generated field are dead surface on every session read, and the header comment states a false rationale.
recommended_fix: Drop rc.form_token from the SELECT (and regen via squirrel), or actually consume it (e.g. redirect when the URL token drifts from the row token) so the comment and the column agree.
